Type.evidence_source: Given the significant stigma round male suicide and the current study goal to describe men's perspectives of losing a male to suicide, photovoice was adapted as a means to facilitate participant storytelling through both photographs and words (Oliffe & Bottorff, 2007). These visual methods afforded an informal, interactive format to discuss the sensitive and emotionally charged topic of male suicide. The interviews were semistructured, utilizing an interview guide but privileging the participant-produced photographs to drive what was talked about, and ensuring discussion of the issues most important to the men (Oliffe & Bottorff, 2007).
